name: Julian's New Apprentice
source:
You come to the palace with only a job listing and a dream – but who is the mysterious doctor lurking within?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你帶著一則徵才啟事和一個夢想來到宮殿。可那名在宮中暗自活動的神秘醫生，究竟是誰？
